title: Un legado en blanco
style: Use case: stylized-concept. One 16:9 LANDSCAPE story illustration for this game's Faceless prologue. Reference roles: Image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY: FACELESS, a tall lean adult featureless ivory-white mannequin-like hero in a perfectly smooth full-cover white bodysuit including head, hands and feet. Absolutely blank oval head: NO EYES, NO MOUTH, NO NOSE, NO HAIR, NO FACIAL FEATURES, no face mask seams. No exposed anatomy details. Communicate emotion only through posture and hands. Image 2 is TRAIN IDENTITY ONLY when a train is needed: the hero's sentient best friend T.exe, small PURPLE steam locomotive, rectangular purple cab with dark flat roof and round yellow-rim windows, magenta/pink cylindrical boiler with yellow bands, grey circular skull-like front with two red round lights and yellow grille teeth, red front buffer beam, purple wheels and EIGHT thin WHITE articulated spider legs with round joints (four per side). Keep train recognizable, friendly, no new human face. Image 3 is a BLACK INK DRAWING reference, not the subject: take the economical hand-drawn black lines, stark white figure, a few rough hatching strokes and old printed comic feel. SIMPLIFY FAR MORE than the reference. MAIN VISUAL DIRECTION: very SIMPLE, intentionally naive sparse drawing. Figures in BLACK AND WHITE INK only, except the locomotive may have ONE flat purple fill and tiny red/yellow identity accents. Backdrops are extremely basic, like a quick filler drawing: just 2-5 flat SATURATED COLOR areas and a handful of elementary rectangles, circles or triangles. Bright saturated flat background, NOT realistic, not detailed, no rendered lighting, no gradients, no texture painting, no realistic landscapes, no intricate buildings or dense foliage, no Persona style, no crayon. Sparse clean linework with small irregularities; broad empty space is essential. One composition, no panels, no text, lettering, captions, logos, watermark, speech bubbles or UI. All important objects and the full blank head inside safe margins. Opaque illustrated background.

illustrations.prompt: CHAMPION WITHOUT A CHOICE. Faceless stands alone on a small very simple black podium, holding a roughly drawn cup trophy down at his side rather than celebrating. Shoulders heavy, head slightly bowed. A huge flat acid-YELLOW circle behind his blank white head; saturated COBALT-blue sky and flat MAGENTA ground. Only six tiny black triangular crowd silhouettes near bottom edges and two plain vertical pennant shapes. Not a detailed arena. His silhouette dominates center-left; visual contrast public victory versus private weariness. No train in this scene.

THE ORDERS. Faceless in the lower center, black-and-white white-suited blank-faced hero, standing with one hand reluctantly accepting a blank sheet from a large black-sleeved pointing official's hand entering from the upper left. At his other side just two abstract broken toy robot silhouettes on the floor (clean mechanical fragments, no bodies or gore). A simple flat saturated VERMILION-red wall and one dark plum rectangle behind. Floor is one flat orange band, no perspective detail except two black floor lines. Sparse, oppressive and quiet. Faceless head remains perfectly featureless. No train in this scene.

THREE GENERATIONS PASSING DOWN A DUTY. In a single sparse scene, three featureless WHITE black-ink mannequin men arranged left-to-right: slightly stooped grandfather on left, broad older father in middle, and young adult Faceless on right. All heads completely blank, no hair or facial features. The father offers the same simple black cup/champion baton toward Faceless while grandfather rests a hand on father's shoulder. Faceless reaches for the object hesitantly with lowered shoulders. Grandfather and father are older only through posture and proportions, not faces. Background merely a saturated TURQUOISE rectangle wall and flat hot-PINK floor, with TWO simple empty black picture frames on wall, no room detail. No train.

THE LIFE HE WANTS. Faceless seated on a plain wooden stool at one very simple table, body fully covered smooth ivory white, blank oval head inclined affectionately toward an open sketchbook. His pen hand draws a tiny simple flower and a wobbly little landscape in black ink on paper, other hand steadying notebook. Expressive quiet absorbed posture. A few spare black hatch lines on his shoulder and beneath table, otherwise clean white figure. Saturated ULTRAMARINE background with a single flat lemon-YELLOW square window showing one bright GREEN hill and one plain white cloud. Only one small pencil cup. Intentionally empty filler background, no elaborate studio, no full room rendering. No train.

HIS BEST FRIEND HAS A SOUL. Faceless seated on a simple low platform at left, resting his white hand gently on the purple boiler of T.exe locomotive at right, blank head tilted toward her as if confiding. T.exe has exactly the purple rectangular cab, magenta cylindrical boiler with yellow rings, grey round skull front with red circular eyes and small yellow grille, red buffer and EIGHT WHITE thin spider legs of train reference, simplified into a charming sparse ink drawing with flat purple fill only. Her round red lamps attentive, subtle front tilt toward him; she feels alive without becoming a different locomotive. One single simple railway line under her. Background is flat saturated CORAL-pink sky, one enormous flat tangerine sun half cut by a single deep-blue horizon stripe. No scenery beyond these three shapes. Tender friendship, not romantic.

WAR INTERRUPTS A DRAWING, AN IDEA BEGINS. Medium-wide view of Faceless inside T.exe's simple purple cab, seated at left holding an open sketchbook and a pencil. Blank white face tilted from paper toward the big window at right; one hand on the purple window ledge as if sharing a new thought with his sentient train friend. Window frame and wall are two or three flat purple rectangles with one yellow circular rim detail that visually matches T.exe. Outside the window: flat ELECTRIC-CYAN sky, one hot MAGENTA ground strip, TWO elementary black triangular UFO silhouettes and a single orange zigzag burst far in distance to suggest a war. NOTHING detailed or realistic. The sketchbook remains mostly white with a few tiny black drawing marks. A small simple yellow ink-outlined lightbulb symbol above his lifted pencil suggests an idea without text. His head absolutely smooth and featureless. Keep mood thoughtful and hopeful amid chaos, not battle action.

pages.es: Me llaman Faceless. Aquí suelen añadir «el campeón» y esperar que salude. Lo hago, por supuesto. Me preocupa que alguien crea que lo estoy ignorando; no tengo una cara que ayude mucho a aclararlo.
pages.en: My name is Faceless. Here they usually add “the champion” and expect a greeting. I oblige, of course. I worry someone might think I am ignoring them; my face does little to clarify things.
pages.pt: Me chamam de Faceless. Aqui costumam acrescentar «o campeão» e esperar uma saudação. Cumprimento, claro. Receio que pensem que estou ignorando alguém; meu rosto não ajuda muito a esclarecer.
pages.ja: 僕はフェイスレス。この星では「王者」と付け加えられ、挨拶を期待される。もちろん応じるよ。無視したと思われたくないからね。表情では説明しにくい顔をしているし。

pages.es: Mi trabajo consiste en competir y destruir a quien me indiquen. Antes de salir pregunto si de verdad hace falta. La respuesta suele llegar con unas coordenadas, así que guardo el cuaderno y voy. No me gusta admitir lo bien que aprendí a hacerlo.
pages.en: My work is to compete and destroy whoever I am directed toward. Before leaving I ask if it is necessary. The answer usually includes coordinates, so I put my sketchbook away and go. I dislike admitting how well I learned the job.
pages.pt: Meu trabalho é competir e destruir quem me indicarem. Antes de sair pergunto se é mesmo necessário. A resposta costuma vir com coordenadas, então guardo o caderno e vou. Não gosto de admitir como aprendi bem esse trabalho.
pages.ja: 仕事は競い、指定された相手を倒すことだ。出発前には本当に必要か尋ねる。大抵、座標付きの答えが来るので、画帳をしまって向かう。上達してしまったことは認めたくないね。

pages.es: Mi padre fue campeón antes que yo, y antes lo fue mi abuelo. En casa se hablaba de las victorias como si fueran recuerdos de viajes. Yo preguntaba cómo eran los lugares y acababan explicándome cómo habían ganado allí.
pages.en: My father was champion before me, and my grandfather before him. At home they discussed victories like travel memories. I would ask what the places looked like, and they would explain how they had won there.
pages.pt: Meu pai foi campeão antes de mim, e meu avô antes dele. Em casa falavam das vitórias como lembranças de viagem. Eu perguntava como eram os lugares e acabavam me explicando como venceram neles.
pages.ja: 父も祖父も王者だった。家では勝利の話が旅行の思い出のように語られた。どんな場所だったか尋ねると、そこでどう勝ったかの説明になってしまうんだ。

pages.es: Les tengo cariño y no quería decepcionarlos. Acepté la locomotora, los entrenamientos y el título. Lo de querer otra vida lo fui dejando para una conversación más tranquila. Siempre parecía haber una ceremonia antes.
pages.en: I love them and did not want to disappoint them. I accepted the locomotive, the training and the title. I kept postponing the conversation about wanting another life until a quieter moment. There always seemed to be a ceremony first.
pages.pt: Tenho carinho por eles e não queria decepcionar. Aceitei a locomotiva, os treinos e o título. Deixava a conversa sobre querer outra vida para um momento tranquilo. Sempre parecia haver uma cerimônia antes.
pages.ja: 家族は大切だし、がっかりさせたくなかった。機関車も訓練も称号も受け入れた。別の人生を望む話は、落ち着いた時にと思っていた。その前にはいつも式典がある気がしたけれど。

pages.es: Lo que me gusta es dibujar. Puedo pasarme una tarde intentando entender cómo se dobla una hoja. Luego alguien me pregunta si estoy preparando una estrategia. Suelo mostrarle el dibujo. Todavía no he convencido a todos de que solo era una hoja.
pages.en: What I enjoy is drawing. I can spend an afternoon studying how a leaf folds. Then someone asks if I am planning a strategy. I show them the sketch. I have not yet convinced everyone it was only a leaf.
pages.pt: Eu gosto mesmo é de desenhar. Posso passar a tarde entendendo como uma folha se dobra. Depois alguém pergunta se preparo uma estratégia. Mostro o desenho. Ainda não convenci todos de que era só uma folha.
pages.ja: 僕が好きなのは絵を描くことだ。葉の折れ方を見ているだけで午後が終わる。戦略を練っているのかと聞かれたら絵を見せる。ただの葉だったと、まだ全員には信じてもらえていない。

pages.es: Me gustaría aprender sin tener que mirar el reloj entre dos encargos. Dibujar personas que pudieran quedarse quietas porque están cómodas, no porque acabo de derrotarlas. Por ahora practico con lo que encuentro cerca de las vías.
pages.en: I would like to learn without watching the clock between assignments. To draw people sitting still because they are comfortable, not because I have just defeated them. For now I practice with what I find beside the tracks.
pages.pt: Gostaria de aprender sem olhar o relógio entre missões. Desenhar pessoas paradas porque estão confortáveis, não porque acabei de derrotá-las. Por enquanto pratico com o que encontro perto dos trilhos.
pages.ja: 任務の合間に時計を気にせず学びたい。僕に倒されたからではなく、くつろいで座っている人を描きたい。今は線路の近くで見つけたものを描いて練習している。

pages.es: Mi mejor amiga es T.exe, mi locomotora. Está viva y tiene bastante carácter. Cuando le enseño un boceto, se inclina para verlo mejor. Le dediqué un cuaderno entero; sostiene que he dibujado su chimenea demasiado corta.
pages.en: My best friend is T.exe, my locomotive. She is alive and has quite a personality. When I show her a sketch, she leans closer. I devoted an entire sketchbook to her; she maintains I made her chimney too short.
pages.pt: Minha melhor amiga é T.exe, minha locomotiva. Está viva e tem bastante personalidade. Quando mostro um esboço, se inclina para ver melhor. Dediquei um caderno inteiro a ela; insiste que fiz sua chaminé curta demais.
pages.ja: 親友は機関車のT.exe。生きていて、なかなかの性格だ。下絵を見せると身を傾けてのぞく。画帳一冊を彼女に捧げたのに、煙突が短すぎると言われている。

pages.es: Nos gusta viajar juntos. Lo que me agota es que cada viaje tenga que acabar en una pelea. Se lo conté una noche en la cabina, con el cuaderno sobre las rodillas. T.exe esperó a que terminara y acercó un poco más la luz.
pages.en: We enjoy traveling together. What exhausts me is every journey having to end in a fight. I told her one night in the cab, my sketchbook on my knees. T.exe waited until I finished and brought the light a little closer.
pages.pt: Gostamos de viajar juntos. O que me esgota é cada viagem precisar acabar numa luta. Contei isso numa noite na cabine, com o caderno no colo. T.exe esperou eu terminar e aproximou um pouco a luz.
pages.ja: 一緒に旅をするのは好きだ。疲れるのは、毎回戦いで終わること。ある夜、膝に画帳を置いて運転室で話した。T.exeは最後まで聞いて、明かりを少し近づけてくれた。

pages.es: Desde entonces empecé a guardar también los dibujos que me salían mal. Antes los tiraba por vergüenza. Ahora me gusta volver a ellos y ver qué intentaba hacer. T.exe tiene algunos en la cabina. Le pedí que no los enseñara durante las inspecciones.
pages.en: After that I began keeping even the drawings that went wrong. I used to discard them out of embarrassment. Now I like revisiting what I was trying to do. T.exe keeps some in the cab. I asked her not to display them during inspections.
pages.pt: Depois comecei a guardar também os desenhos que saíam errados. Antes jogava fora por vergonha. Agora gosto de rever o que tentava fazer. T.exe guarda alguns na cabine. Pedi que não mostrasse durante as inspeções.
pages.ja: それから失敗した絵も残すようになった。以前は恥ずかしくて捨てていたけれど、何を描こうとしたか見返すのも好きになった。T.exeは運転室に何枚か置いている。点検中は見せないでと頼んだよ。

pages.es: Cuando anunciaron la guerra, llegaron más encargos y empezaron a cambiar nuestras rutas. Oí a mi jefe prometer que el campeón se ocuparía de los invasores. Me habría gustado estar presente cuando me ofrecí voluntario.
pages.en: When war was announced, more assignments arrived and our routes changed. I heard my boss promise the champion would handle the invaders. I would have liked to be present when I volunteered.
pages.pt: Quando anunciaram a guerra, chegaram mais missões e mudaram nossas rotas. Ouvi meu chefe prometer que o campeão cuidaria dos invasores. Gostaria de ter estado presente quando me ofereci como voluntário.
pages.ja: 開戦が告げられると任務が増え、経路も変わった。上司が、侵入者は王者に任せればいいと言うのを聞いた。僕が志願した時には、僕もその場にいたかったな。

pages.es: No quería seguir haciendo daño, pero tampoco sabía cómo decir que me iba. Ensayé una renuncia con T.exe. Me salió tan solemne que terminé pidiéndole disculpas a la puerta. Ella esperó. Volví a intentarlo.
pages.en: I did not want to keep hurting people, but I did not know how to say I was leaving. I rehearsed a resignation with T.exe. It sounded so solemn I ended up apologizing to the door. She waited. I tried again.
pages.pt: Não queria continuar machucando ninguém, mas não sabia dizer que ia embora. Ensaiei uma renúncia com T.exe. Ficou tão solene que terminei pedindo desculpas à porta. Ela esperou. Tentei outra vez.
pages.ja: 誰かを傷つけ続けたくはなかった。でも辞めると言い出せなかった。T.exeと辞表の言い方を練習したら、仰々しくなりすぎて扉に謝ってしまった。彼女は待ってくれた。もう一度試したよ。

pages.es: Entonces pensé en el título. Si necesitaban un campeón que siempre ganara, quizá una derrota bastaría para que me dejaran marchar. Se lo expliqué a T.exe. No pareció impresionada con la idea, pero ya me había acercado el cuaderno para preparar la actuación.
pages.en: Then I thought about the title. If they needed a champion who always won, perhaps a defeat would let me leave. I explained it to T.exe. She did not seem impressed, but had already brought my sketchbook closer to plan the performance.
pages.pt: Então pensei no título. Se precisavam de um campeão que sempre vencesse, talvez uma derrota me deixasse partir. Expliquei a T.exe. Não pareceu impressionada, mas já havia aproximado o caderno para planejar a atuação.
pages.ja: そこで称号を思い出した。必ず勝つ王者が必要なら、一度負ければ辞めさせてもらえるかもしれない。T.exeに説明した。感心した様子はなかったけれど、演技を考えるための画帳はもう寄せてくれていた。

scope: Prólogo integrado en la campaña completa de cinco capítulos; textos sincronizados con faceless_story_dialogues.json.
